source: Official IDECOR Geoserver WFS; layers idecor:area_quemada_2022 through idecor:area_quemada_2026; GeoJSON
selection: All published features in each annual layer, no feature selection by geometry or outcome
comparison_locations: Eight fixed Argentine catalog fire-sector center coordinates in training/data/environmental/geography.json
distance_method: Transform original GeoJSON geometry from its declared CRS to EPSG:4326, then compute approximate local equirectangular point-to-polygon distance from each sector center; a sector center is not the full trail geometry
target_semantics: Official mapped burned-area perimeter and recorded fire date; not exact ignition time or an active-fire sensor truth label
